calls.title: Ronald Koh and August Allard
calls.summary: The team focused on resolving a GrowthBook issue where data was not reaching GA4 due to a missing tracking callback. Kevin Chant emphasized the need for a tracking mechanism, while Ronald guided the customer on implementing the required callback. They also fixed an API host configuration error caused by using a cloud domain instead of the customer's own domain. The team validated GA4 integration documentation and discussed internal processes for replicating issues. Insights were shared on how the support team efficiently resolves most issues independently, while proactive alerting and automation were highlighted as essential for improving customer experience. Lastly, the immediate next steps in the recruitment process were outlined.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, GA4, JavaScript SDK, tracking callback, self-hosting, API host
calls.action_items:
**Ronald Koh**
Follow up with the customer to confirm whether their tracking callback integration uses Google Tag Manager or direct GA4 tracking implementation (08:52)
Send GrowthBook GA4 integration documentation to the customer explaining the two integration paths (Google Tag Manager and direct GA4 tracking) for configuring the tracking callback (16:14)
Share self-hosting documentation with the customer detailing environment variables including API host setup to resolve the “invalid API host” error (25:30)

**Kevin Chant**
Review customer code and Slack thread for similar common GA4 data transmission issues to support troubleshooting efforts (06:49)
Assist Ronald in verifying proper GA4 tracking callback configurations and domain naming conventions for self-hosted customers to resolve data transmission errors (19:06)

**GrowthBook Support/Engineering Team**
Provide better alerting mechanisms on API or endpoint downtime to support team for proactive customer notifications and improved customer experience (29:53)
Conduct technical screens with Ronald for candidate evaluation and respond to the candidate by the following Monday or Tuesday, with the next stage being a call with co-founders (39:32)
